senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. Kedar, name of a tribe of Arabs.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:5:4">Cant. R. to I, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23:10">Ex. R. s. 23</cite> <he>ישמעאלים</he>).
<cite ref="Beitzah 20b:1">Bets. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>צאן ק׳</he> sheep from Kedar; a. e.—Denom. <he>קִדְרִי</he>; pl. <he>קִדְרִיִּים</he>.
<cite ref="Taanit 5b:2">Taan. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ עובדין למים</he> the Kedarites worship water.
